interpretation: The 26 methods share the same original deterministic detector decisions; 10000 DeepShield and 4000 OpenFake are reused, not new independent samples.

All learned variants were fitted on the archived training split. Except for original frozen_v4, their own thresholds are development_only_not_certified.

lr_full and frozen_v4 have equal stored AURC and matched-count point metrics on both cohorts, but model receipts and threshold provenance remain distinct. Contrasts are preserved under their actual original method IDs.

MLP margin variants substantially improve OpenFake whole-curve AURC over the frozen profile, with all three existing paired intervals favoring MLP. They retain more errors at original k=3639, showing an operating-point tradeoff.
No post-hoc winner is adopted from these data. The independent replacement decision concerns the separately frozen resize-only candidate and retains the full selector under its prespecified rule.
For MLP rows the main table reports mean AURC and error-count range across seeds 17,29,43. Individual seed values and every available original paired interval are retained here.
